entries.title_zh: 学生抗议要求系统性变革
entries.summary_en: Viral posts describe early June 2026 student protests across Indonesia calling for forced change against corruption, economy, and elite impunity. Youth declare patience is running out.
entries.summary_zh: 病毒式帖子描述2026年6月初印尼各地学生抗议，呼吁对抗腐败、经济问题和精英免责，青年宣称耐心已尽。

entries.title_en: Indonesian economy collapse fears
entries.title_zh: 印尼经济崩溃担忧
entries.summary_en: X users repeatedly warn of impending economic collapse due to Prabowo policies, rupiah decline, and loss of investor trust after Sri Mulyani dismissal. Discussions highlight market distrust and potential rating downgrade as key triggers.
entries.summary_zh: X用户反复警告普拉博沃政策导致印尼经济即将崩溃，印尼盾贬值，投资者信任丧失。讨论强调市场不信任和评级下调风险。

entries.title_en: Indonesia carbon market launch
entries.title_zh: 印尼碳市场启动
entries.summary_en: Official and analyst posts highlight June 2026 as start of full-scale carbon trading, with activity expected July onward, positioning Indonesia for climate sovereignty.
entries.summary_zh: 官方与分析师帖子强调2026年6月为全面碳交易启动月，7月起活跃交易，助力印尼气候主权。

entries.title_en: BBM Subsidy Allocation Effectiveness
entries.title_zh: BBM补贴分配有效性
entries.summary_en: Posts reference Rp153.1 trillion subsidy allocation for BBM, gas and electricity amid rising global oil prices and rupiah contraction. Debate centers on whether subsidies prevent price spikes and their long-term fiscal impact.
entries.summary_zh: 帖子提及在全球油价上涨和印尼盾收缩背景下，153.1万亿印尼盾用于BBM、天然气和电力补贴的分配。辩论焦点在于补贴是否能防止价格飙升及其长期财政影响。

entries.title_en: Female Candidate Quota Implementation
entries.title_zh: 女性候选人配额实施
entries.summary_en: Discussions on MK decision enforcing 30% female caleg quota in revised election law, with party leaders voicing support.
entries.summary_zh: 讨论宪法法院裁决在修订选举法中强制执行30%女性候选人配额，政党领导人表示支持。

entries.title_en: Political Money in Pilkada Campaigns
entries.title_zh: 地方选举竞选中的政治金钱
entries.summary_en: Posts criticize ongoing political money practices in Pilkada despite anti-corruption messaging from parties and officials.
entries.summary_zh: 帖子批评地方选举中持续的政治金钱做法，尽管政党和官员有反腐信息。

entries.title_en: MK Rulings on Election Law Revisions
entries.title_zh: 宪法法院对选举法修订的裁决
entries.summary_en: Posts reference MK decisions on pemilu regulations and paths to 2029 elections, including discussions on term limits and candidate eligibility. Official accounts and analysts note binding nature of rulings.
entries.summary_zh: 帖子引用宪法法院对选举法规的裁决，以及通往2029年选举的路径，包括任期限制和候选人资格讨论。官方账号和分析师指出裁决具有约束力。

entries.title_en: Shoot-on-Sight Orders for Street Crime
entries.title_zh: 街头犯罪“见人即射”命令
entries.summary_en: HRW and X users criticize new police/military shoot-on-sight policies against street crime, warning of unlawful force and expanded military role in civilian policing. Debate questions public safety gains versus human rights risks.
entries.summary_zh: 人权观察和X用户批评针对街头犯罪的新警/军“见人即射”政策，警告非法使用武力和扩大军方在民事执法中的作用。辩论质疑公共安全收益与人权风险。

entries.title_en: Prabowo government approval and criticism
entries.title_zh: 普拉博沃政府支持率与批评
entries.summary_en: Mixed X chatter around Prabowo includes fan defense, accusations of indifference to public pain, and calls for accountability on economy and governance.
entries.summary_zh: X上关于普拉博沃的混合讨论包括粉丝辩护、指责其对民众痛苦漠不关心，以及要求经济和治理问责。

entries.title_en: Rupiah currency crisis debate
entries.title_zh: 印尼盾货币危机辩论
entries.summary_en: Users debate rupiah freefall and survey discrepancies, with accusations of government denial versus international warnings of deeper problems.
entries.summary_zh: 用户辩论印尼盾暴跌和调查差异，指责政府否认与国际警告的深层问题。
